summary_en: Komatsu completed cancellation of 15,303,700 shares (1.6% of pre-cancellation issued shares) on October 30, 2026, acquired under a buyback program authorized April 28, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Komatsu completed the cancellation of 15,303,700 treasury shares on October 30, 2026. These shares had been acquired under a buyback program authorized by the board of directors on April 28, 2026, which permitted the company to acquire up to 25 million shares or 10 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from April 30 to September 30, 2026. The canceled shares represented 1.6% of the issued share count prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company's outstanding share count stood at 915,036,920 shares.
